name: EffiBench
description: EffiBench is a benchmark consisting of 1,000 efficiency-critical coding problems designed to assess the efficiency of code generated by code generation models, comparing their performance against human-written canonical solutions optimized for efficiency.
reputation: A recent benchmark from the code-efficiency evaluation literature that is cited for measuring runtime and memory quality of generated code, but it has not yet become a broadly standardized community benchmark.
notes: Focuses on efficiency rather than correctness; includes leaderboard and source code publicly available.
